{{Quote|Here, for instance, is the story of a ''Jedi'' who chose to learn the ways of the ''dark side''&mdash;like you''[,]'' he believed the dark side could be ''conquered'' from within.|Odan-Urr, to Ulic Qel-Droma|<ref name="DLotS4" />}}
A '''Human''' served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] at some point by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Believing that learning the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] could help eradicate it, the Knight eventually had an argument with his former [[Teacher/Legends|master]], another [[Unidentified Human Jedi (Dark Holocron)|Jedi]]. The Knight, succumbing to anger due to the corrupting influence of the dark side, ultimately [[Death/Legends|slew]] his teacher, an act which came to be recorded in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Holocron]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The dark side ''seduced'' him utterly&hellip;and ''anger'' became his path. In the end he turned ''against'' his own master.|Odan-Urr|<ref name="DLotS4" />}}
[[File:DarkHolocronJediDeath-DLotS4.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Dark Holocron's depiction of the Jedi Knight killing his teacher]]
A [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="DLotS4" /> at some point by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="5000 BBY">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]] establishes that the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had recorded an account of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] in the [[Dark Holocron]]. [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]] further depicts [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] recovering the [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> He was originally [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticed]] to another [[Unidentified Human Jedi (Dark Holocron)|Human Jedi]]. At one point, the Jedi Knight came to believe that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]&mdash;the opposite of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] wielded by the Jedi Order&mdash;could be eradicated by first learning to use it, which he then decided to do. The Jedi Knight's choices eventually led him to an argument with his Jedi [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]]. During the confrontation, the Knight became agitated and, having by that point become corrupted by the dark side, he let his own anger control his actions. Drawing his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Knight ultimately [[Death/Legends|cut down]] his former master.<ref name="DLotS4" />

An account of the Jedi Knight's fall to the dark side and his confrontation with his teacher, accompanied by imagery depicting the event, was recorded in the [[Dark Holocron]]<ref name="DLotS4" /> of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] was recovered by Jedi Knight [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]]<ref name="TFotSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> in 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="5000 BBY" /> and it remained in [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] possession<ref name="DLotS4" /> for a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]. In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="3997 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]] to [[3997 BBY]].</ref> when Jedi Knight [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] prepared to infiltrate the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult of [[darksider]]s in order to defeat them, the long-lived Odan-Urr showed Qel-Droma the Dark Holocron's recording concerning the fallen Jedi Knight in an attempt to persuade Qel-Droma into abandoning his plan. Although Qel-Droma was stunned by the images of the Knight killing his master, he failed to see how the story related to him and continued with his intentions.<ref name="DLotS4" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi Knight was a bald [[Human/Legends|Human]]. He was overconfident in his ability to withstand the corrupting influence of the dark side of the Force, which ultimately led to him succumbing to anger and killing his Jedi teacher.<ref name="DLotS4" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi Knight wore a [[Cape/Legends|cape]] and an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Clothing/Legends|skirt]] as well as a pair of pants, [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]]. He wielded an ornate lightsaber.<ref name="DLotS4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Knight appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|fourth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was authored by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], illustrated by [[Chris Gossett]],<ref name="DLotS4" /> and published on [[January 10]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54574/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_4|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #4}}</ref>
